body:
## Summary
- Tighten native pointer HID Android log parsing so the gate requires exact mouse-class source tokens instead of substring matches.
- Add a gate observation requiring move, primary press, and primary release to share one external mouse-like Android deviceId.
- Refresh the blocked P0110 native-pointer summary/checksum and document the stricter evidence requirement.

## Verification
- git fetch origin main; branch is based on origin/main a02cf7caea1e31f9dc7745237a7571b6cc56dd00.
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_native_pointer_hid scripts.tests.test_native_pointer_hid_acceptance scripts.tests.test_peripheral_host_ready_fail_closed -v -> 44 tests OK.
- make native-pointer-hid-gate EVIDENCE_DIR=docs/changes/2026-08-05-phase-1-android-client/evidence/2026-08-31-p0110-native-pointer-hid-current-base-blocked -> exits 2, existing no-HID/no-Host evidence remains fail-closed.
- cd docs/changes/2026-08-05-phase-1-android-client/evidence/2026-08-31-p0110-native-pointer-hid-current-base-blocked && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS -> all OK.
- make evidence-tools-test -> 1465 tests OK.
- git diff --check -> OK.
- adb -s <redacted-adb-serial> reverse --list before/after device-related checks -> empty.

## Remaining risks
- This is fail-closed tooling hardening only. It does not run Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI, does not run swift run, does not touch Screen Recording/Accessibility/Microphone/Keychain/TCC, and does not perform physical HID E2E.
- Native pointer HID mouse acceptance still needs a stable signed/TCC-ready Host plus real Android-attached HID mouse evidence from one observation window.
title: test(evidence): harden native pointer HID gate
